summary: Observability readiness controls were added for Sentry configuration, redacted structured logging, protected readiness, enterprise storage/scanner readiness, alerting, incident response, rollback and customer communication runbooks.
redactionConfirmation: All secrets, tokens, credentials, connection strings, and access-granting values are redacted.
controlsVerified: Sentry client config disables default PII and strips request/user fields before send.
Sentry server config disables default PII and strips request/user fields before send.
Sentry edge config disables default PII and strips request/user fields before send.
The Sentry Next.js wrapper remains enabled so runtime instrumentation and the /monitoring tunnel are registered.
Source-map and release artifact upload options are only supplied when SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN, SENTRY_ORG and SENTRY_PROJECT are all present.
Central logger redacts secrets, tokens, cookies, sessions and avoidable PII.
Central logger includes requestId and only includes safe organizationId values.
Standardized security events are exported and test-covered.
/api/ready checks Supabase connectivity and grouped Stripe, Redis and Sentry config without exposing values.
/api/ready checks enterprise storage/scanner readiness when RELEASE_TARGET=enterprise, RISCK_COMPLY_ENTERPRISE_RELEASE=true, or REQUIRE_MALWARE_SCAN_FOR_UPLOADS=true.
/api/ready does not expose scanner endpoint, allowed host, token or environment variable names.
Sensitive error reporting returns sanitized error metadata and captures Sentry exceptions with sanitized extra context.
Alerting, incident response, rollback and customer communication runbooks exist for SEV-1 and SEV-2 operations.
Release readiness gates require incident and rollback owners before release sign-off.

sourceMaps.accidentalUploadGuard: withSentryConfig stays enabled for runtime instrumentation and the tunnel route, but source-map and release artifact upload settings are only supplied when SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN, SENTRY_ORG and SENTRY_PROJECT are all present.

checks: Sentry source-map upload credentials present when release uploads are expected
Enterprise controlled document storage bucket constant

notes: Operational owner names, rollback target URL and rollback target SHA are maintained in the release approval record instead of being duplicated in runtime evidence.
CI command output must be attached before production release sign-off.
